notes.title: Update 1.1.0: optimization and game difficulty level.
notes.content:
Hello all!

We are glad to present you the game update to version 1.1.0

List of changes:

[olist]
[*]The game engine version has been updated to Godot 3.5.2. Thanks to this, all the changes and improvements to the engine are now available to you.
[*]Serious additional optimization of the game code has been carried out, thanks to which the game should work a little better on weak devices.
[*]Added the choice of the level of difficulty of the game. On hard difficulty, the enemies are more deadly and the puzzles are unforgiving.
[/olist]

If you are Linux user, please note that the 32-bit Linux version build was not changed. Please use 64-bit Linux version to apply this update.

In addition, the game was recently released on the Epic Games Store.

Sincerely,
NLB project team

notes.title: The problem with loading saves from the demo in the full version of the game
notes.content:
Hello all!

Recently, one of the players refunded the game and wrote the following in a comment:

[b]Finished the demo version of this game, liked the game very much, decided to buy it, but the game does not go beyond the demo version[/b]

First of all, thanks for the detailed comment on why you didn't like the game, this is very important for us!

Regarding the problem: you'll need to start the game from the beginning, if you played the demo before, unfortunately, save files from the demo version are incompatible with the full version. Sorry for this, we should have at least mention this somewhere because right now it is completely unobvious. If you have a similar problem, start a new game from the main menu; remember that you can skip dialogs in the game by pressing a button to save time.

Thanks again for the comment on the refund! If you have any problems with the game, then please try first to ask us for advice on the game forum, we try to read all comments and respond to them.

Best regards,
NLB project team

[*]Shooting improved a little bit (you cannot take back the arrow loaded in the bow)
[/list]

Best regards,
NLB project team

notes.title: Palladium: Adventure in Greece is now in the Steam store!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

A couple of days ago we finally released the game we've been working on for the last two years. This is a great event for our small team.
Palladium is a first-person 3D adventure quest where you play as an archaeologist who explores an ancient labyrinth. He will have to solve riddles based on myths of ancient Greece. He can do so alone or take one of two possible companions. Each companion has his unique way of solving riddles, so if you finish the game with one companion, you can play again with another.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137270/Palladium_Adventure_in_Greece/

To celebrate the release of the game, we decided to make a sale of all our previous games, making the highest discounts we had ever made. The sale will take place on Steam from the 7th to the 13th of June 2021. Some of our games have Steam trading cards.

We sincerely hope you will enjoy our games, and especially Palladium: Adventure in Greece!
Please share your opinion about the game on its Steam page. We appreciate all the feedback we can get!

Yours faithfully,
NLB project team
